sloka: राजभिः धृत दण्डाः च कृत्वा पापानि मानवाः ।निर्मलाः स्वर्गम् आयान्ति सन्तः सुकृतिनो यथा ॥४-१८-३१॥
transliteration: rājabhiḥ dhṛta daṇḍāḥ ca kṛtvā pāpāni mānavāḥ ।nirmalāḥ svargam āyānti santaḥ sukṛtino yathā ॥4-18-31॥

translations.english: 'You should also have acted in that manner considering dharma. Now listen to what Manu said, in two verses that hold good traditions dear which are accepted by men wellversed in dharma. O monkey the action taken by me is in conformity with this.
